hero.slide1Subtitle: Join Us in Making a Difference
hero.slide1Desc: We are dedicated to creating lasting change through education, healthcare, and sustainable development programs for underserved communities in Bangladesh.
hero.slide2Desc: Oikkoparishad provides quality education and scholarships to underprivileged children, ensuring no child is left behind.
hero.slide3Title: Join Us in Making a Difference
hero.slide3Desc: Through free medical camps and health awareness programs, we bring essential healthcare services to remote communities across Jalalabad.
hero.slide4Desc: For over 75 years, Oikkoparishad has been serving communities across Bangladesh with dedication, integrity, and a vision for a brighter future for all.

footer.description: Oikkoparishad is a non-political, non-profit voluntary social welfare organization dedicated to improving the lives of underserved communities in Bangladesh since 1948.

home.aboutDesc1: Oikkoparishad is a non-profit organization focused on uplifting underprivileged communities. Since our founding in 1948, we have been working tirelessly to provide education, healthcare, and sustainable livelihood opportunities to those who need them most.
home.aboutDesc2: Our mission is to empower individuals through community-driven programs that create lasting positive change across Bangladesh.
home.presidentQuote: "Oikkoparishad has been a beacon of hope and progress for our community since 1948. Through decades of dedicated service, we have touched countless lives through education, healthcare, and empowerment initiatives. Our journey continues with renewed vigor and commitment to serve."
home.secretaryQuote: "As Secretary, I am honored to work alongside dedicated volunteers and staff who share our vision for a better tomorrow. Together, we have built schools, provided healthcare, and empowered women across Jalalabad. Our work is far from done, and I invite you to join us."
